source: headline numbers copied from the docs named per study; the random-fill numbers recomputed from results/random_fill_baseline.json (summary, n-weighted)

studies.name: Random-fill baseline
studies.setup: 43 VGCPastes starting teams outside the top 50 (mean win rate 0.446); 94 cells of mask kind x size, one random legal fill each
studies.headline: A random legal fill costs 18.5 points of win rate on average: natures -0.2, abilities -0.9, Stat Points -1.6, items -6.7, moves -22.1, mixed parts -24.8, whole Pokémon -27.4.
studies.files: code/src/random_fill_baseline.py; results/random_fill_baseline.json in the vgc-team-generator-pilot repository; vault image Random-fill baseline — seven tasks.png

studies.name: Ling pilot
studies.setup: 63 masks on 3 random legal starting teams; Ling with reasoning off, 4,096 tokens
studies.headline: 27 of 63 legal (42.9%). Legal fills: +1.2 points over the original team, +0.4 over random fills; no reliable advantage. Cost $0.007.

studies.name: Scratch diffusion vs Ling
studies.setup: The pilot's 63 masks, starting teams and battles
studies.headline: Scratch diffusion 62 of 63 legal against Ling's 27 of 63.

studies.name: Ling prompt comparison
studies.setup: 147 masks; original prompt mb-original-v1 against the grounded mb-grounded-v2
studies.headline: Both prompts 65 of 147 legal (44.2%); scratch diffusion v3 147 of 147. Battles never scored.

studies.name: Dense mask grid
studies.setup: 306 masks covering every mask size, 3 starting teams
studies.headline: Ling 54 of 306 legal, scratch diffusion 303 of 306; on the 54 both got legal, diffusion minus Ling -0.4 points.

studies.name: Regulation prompt test
studies.setup: 294 masks; Ling with the regulation prompt mb-regulation-v3 against mb-original-v1 sampled at the same time
studies.headline: 170 of 294 legal against 139 (+10.5 points [+6.8, +14.3]); win rate of legal teams unchanged (0.498 against 0.496).
